decisions.statement: The food's name is the first word.
One call names one food.
A step after the entry never turns a written entry into a failed run.
A run says which steps after the entry did not land.
A run that refuses having written no entry says the fault alone.
A run that refuses having written the entry names that entry and each write past it.
A fault carries the code that fault names and says where it was thrown.
Which day an entry counts to is worked out from when the entry happened against when Alan woke.
A wall clock said here is read in Mountain.
A wall time no Mountain instant reads as is refused rather than settled on.
A date said with no time is read as noon.
A time said with no date is read on today.
An entry is filed under the day and the food's name.
An entry is numbered where that name is taken on that day.
The hundred characters a page's slug holds bound the whole slug rather than the stem inside it.
The page type opening the slug and the number ending it are both counted against that length.
Whether an object store is there is settled before anything is written.
A photo the entry could not have leaves that photo where that photo is.
Nothing here mends an entry already written.
Nothing here reads a photo from anywhere but this machine.
The photo a call names is published as the entry's cover.

definition: the command filing one food Alan ate onto the day that food counts to
